override.markedHint: You marked this as covered manually.

companion.disclaimer: The companion gives data and questions; it never writes your answer for you.
companion.error: Could not get orientation. Please try again.
companion.simplifyHint: No jargon + a concrete example of the method.
companion.exampleTitle: Example of the method in another passage

gate.title: Before generating your sermon
gate.intro: Here's what we tracked of your work on this passage. Not a score: it's the actual coverage of your study.
gate.weakDimsTitle: Some dimensions are not yet covered
gate.weakDimsHint: I recommend going deeper before preaching. Concrete starting points:

promptFor.D1_lectura: Did you re-read the full passage and record your first impression?
promptFor.D2_contextoGenero: Confirm the literary genre and write how it changes your reading rules.
promptFor.D3_estructura: Identify the climactic clause and how the rest of the passage supports it.
promptFor.D4_palabras: Add at least 2 key-word studies with your own discovery.
promptFor.D5_reconocimiento: Find 1-3 canonical parallels with clear theological weight (no proof-texting).
promptFor.D6_funcion: Articulate what the text did to its original audience before applying it today.
promptFor.D7_confrontacion: Confront at least one significant contrary position and dismantle it from the text: verify your timeless principle and complete witness validation to record it.

gate.justificationLabel: Explain why you consider this study sufficient or why you want to proceed with partial coverage
gate.justificationPlaceholder: E.g. I already covered the parallels in a prior series on this book; accumulated depth supports this sermon…

puzzle.title: Reconstruct the structure
puzzle.description: Place each clause in its zone. A zone may hold several clauses or none — it's not one per zone. If you miss, I give you a hint, never the answer. You find it.
puzzle.error: Could not build the puzzle. Please try again.
puzzle.zoneEmpty: Click a clause and then click here. It can stay empty if you decide so.
puzzle.defaultHint: Look again: what does this clause do grammatically?
puzzle.completeCta: Structure reconstructed! Now write your note →
puzzle.tooLongTitle: Passage too long for the puzzle
puzzle.tooLongBody: The structural puzzle works on pericopes of up to ~{{maxWords}} words (this passage has {{wordCount}}). Narrow your focus to 1-5 key verses.
puzzle.tooLongInputHint: E.g. if you work on Philemon, narrow to Philemon 8-21.
puzzle.needsChapterVerseBody: The structural puzzle works on a concrete pericope. Specify chapter and verses (e.g. "John 3:16" or "Romans 8:28-30"). For short books (Philemon, Jude, 2 John, 3 John, Obadiah) the book name alone is enough.
puzzle.needsChapterVerseInputHint: Type the pericope with chapter and verses.
